hints.title: Post-Order Bottom-Up Aggregation
hints.text: A subtree can only be deleted if its total sum of values is zero, requiring bottom-up sum calculation.

hints.title: Return Subtree Sum and Remaining Count
hints.text: Each node collects subtree sums and remaining node counts from all its children.

hints.title: Prune on Zero Subtree Sum
hints.text: If the accumulated subtree sum equals zero, the count of retained nodes for this entire subtree becomes zero.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in the tree
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-evaluating subtree sums multiple times from the top down takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Single post-order depth traversal aggregates sum and count in linear time and stack memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should propagate both subtree sum and surviving node count simultaneously.
